name: Data Analyzer: Row count check passes when enough rows are present
objective: Shows a table meeting the minimum row count passes and reports how many rows were found.
precondition: Offline test harness; the quality checker is used directly on a small made-up table.

steps.data: 5-row made-up employee table (id, name, age, salary, hire_date, is_active)

name: Data Analyzer: Row count check fails when too few rows are present
objective: Shows a table below the minimum fails with a message stating the count and the minimum.
precondition: Offline test harness; the quality checker is used directly on a small made-up table.

steps.data: 5-row made-up employee table (id, name, age, salary, hire_date, is_active)

name: Data Analyzer: Row count check fails for a table with no rows
objective: Shows an empty table is reported as failing the row count.
precondition: Offline test harness; the quality checker is used directly on a small made-up table.

name: Data Analyzer: Data type check passes when every column matches its declared type
objective: Shows correctly typed columns raise no issues.
precondition: Offline test harness; the quality checker is used directly on a small made-up table.

steps.action: Check types against a declared set
steps.data: 5-row made-up employee table (id, name, age, salary, hire_date, is_active); declared id int, name str, age int, salary float, hire_date str

name: Data Analyzer: Data type check flags a column holding values of the wrong type
objective: Shows a column mixing numbers and words ("1", 2, "three", 4, 5) declared as integer is reported.
precondition: Offline test harness; the quality checker is used directly on a small made-up table.

steps.action: Check a table whose 'mixed' column holds '1', 2, 'three', 4, 5 against a schema saying it is an integer
steps.expected: Fails and the only column flagged is 'mixed'.

name: Data Analyzer: True/false text is accepted for a yes/no column
objective: Shows values "true" and "false" are valid for a boolean column.
precondition: Offline test harness; the quality checker is used directly on a small made-up table.

steps.action: Check the is_active column declared as bool

name: Data Analyzer: Date text is accepted for a date column
objective: Shows valid ISO dates pass a datetime check.
precondition: Offline test harness; the quality checker is used directly on a small made-up table.

steps.action: Check the hire_date column declared as datetime

name: Data Analyzer: Value range check passes when all numbers are inside their limits
objective: Shows in-range numbers raise no issues.
precondition: Offline test harness; the quality checker is used directly on a small made-up table.

steps.data: 5-row made-up employee table (id, name, age, salary, hire_date, is_active); age 20 to 50, salary 40000 to 80000

name: Data Analyzer: Value range check fails when numbers fall outside their limits
precondition: Offline test harness; the quality checker is used directly on a small made-up table.

steps.action: Check ages 25,30,35,28,40 against 30-35 and salaries against a maximum of 50000
steps.expected: Fails with exactly 3 issues: age below 30 on rows 0 and 3, age above 35 on row 4, salary above 50000 on all five rows.

name: Data Analyzer: Allowed-values check passes when every value is in the list
objective: Shows text values that are all on the allowed list raise no issues.
precondition: Offline test harness; the quality checker is used directly on a small made-up table.

steps.action: Check the name column against an allowed list
steps.data: Names Alice, Bob, Charlie, David, Eve; allowed list contains the same five

name: Data Analyzer: Range check is skipped, and passes, when no rules are given
objective: Shows an empty rule set is handled and says so.
precondition: Offline test harness; the quality checker is used directly on a small made-up table.

steps.action: Run the range check with no rules
steps.data: 5-row made-up employee table (id, name, age, salary, hire_date, is_active)
steps.expected: Passed; message contains 'No rules provided, skipping range validation'

name: Data Analyzer: Blank values are not counted as range violations
objective: Shows a missing salary does not make the range check fail.
precondition: Offline test harness; the quality checker is used directly on a small made-up table.

steps.action: Blank one salary, then check salary 40000 to 80000
steps.data: 5-row made-up employee table (id, name, age, salary, hire_date, is_active)

name: Data Analyzer: Summary statistics report size, columns, types and missing values
objective: Shows the summary has the expected sections and the right row and column counts.
precondition: Offline test harness; the quality checker is used directly on a small made-up table.

steps.data: 5-row made-up employee table (id, name, age, salary, hire_date, is_active)
steps.expected: Shape is 5 rows by 6 columns; the summary includes columns, data types, auto-detected types and missing values

name: Data Analyzer: Summary statistics count duplicate rows
precondition: Offline test harness; the quality checker is used directly on a small made-up table.

name: Data Analyzer: Summary statistics include a memory usage figure
objective: Shows a non-negative memory figure is reported.
precondition: Offline test harness; the quality checker is used directly on a small made-up table.

steps.data: 5-row made-up employee table (id, name, age, salary, hire_date, is_active)
steps.expected: A memory usage figure in megabytes is present and zero or more

name: Data Analyzer: Column types are detected automatically
objective: Shows whole numbers, decimals, text and dates are recognised without a declared schema.
precondition: Offline test harness; the quality checker is used directly on a small made-up table.

steps.data: 5-row made-up employee table (id, name, age, salary, hire_date, is_active)
steps.expected: id int; name str; age int; salary float; hire_date datetime (is_active is not checked)
